release.title: Version 1.1.0
release.subtitle: What's new:
new_features: Messaging: inbox and chat threads with websocket integration
Playlists: list view, detail page, and secret playlist deep links
Offline downloads: downloaded tracks/playlists and local file playback
improvements: Home screen: added 'Top playlists' shelf and favorite‑genre trending feed
Library: added playlist sections (liked + recently played) and download entries
CI: updated GitHub Actions and forced Node.js 24 compatibility
Reduced noisy logging in auth, network, and deep link services
Updated reCAPTCHA test page and .env.example Windows URL
